Airing out a boathouse involves opening the doors and windows to allow fresh air and sunlight to flow through, which helps to keep the space fresh and prevent the buildup of moisture and mildew. It's a simple yet effective way to maintain the condition of the boathouse and ensure a pleasant environment for boating enthusiasts. During the process, you might also check the condition of the awning and trestle, ensuring they are in good working order and free from damage. Airing out the boathouse is a great way to refresh the space and create a more inviting atmosphere for those who use it. 

P.P.S. Do not forget the storage shed.
